verses.text: ETERNAL LIFE

Eternal life is a life that has no end, does it mean that man will never die? He must die physically, but spiritually he will live eternally in heaven or eternally suffer in hell. Let's briefly discuss below to understand this topic clearly.
ሰው ሁሉ ኃጢአተኛ ነው

ሰው ከውልደቱ ጀምሮ ኃጢአተኛ ነው፤ በሕይወቱም በተግባሩ፣ በባህሪው፣ በመስማቱ፣ በመናገሩ፣ በማየቱ እና በማሰቡ ኃጢአትን ይሠራል። በማቴዎስ 5:28 ላይ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ ይላል፡- 'እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ሴት ያየ ሁሉ የተመኛትም ያን ጊዜ በልቡ ከእርስዋ ጋር አመንዝሮአል።' ባለማወቅ ኃጢአት የሚሠራ ሰው ማንም ባያየውም እንኳ እንደ ኃጢአት ይቆጠርበታል። ብዙ ሰዎች "ምን ኃጢአት ሠራሁ?" ብለው ያስባሉ እንዲሁም ይናገራሉ። መግደል፣ ማመንዘር፣ መስረቅ ወይም መዝረፍ ብቻ ሳይሆን መዋሸት፣ ማታለል፣ መታበይ፣ ቅናት፣ ስግብግብ መሆን፣ ሐሜት እና በሌሎች ላይ ክፉ ማሰብም ኃጢአት ነው። በእርግጥም እያንዳንዱ ሰው ከተወለደ ጀምሮ ኃጢአተኛ ነው።
Ecclesiastes 7:20 'Indeed, there is no one on earth who is righteous, no one who does what is right and never sins.'
Psalm 51:5 'Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.'
1st John 5:17 'All wrongdoing is sin'
Romans 3:23 'for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,'
Romans 5:12 'Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way, death came to all people, because all sinned'
Romans 6:23 'For the wages of sin is death,'
Every human being must die physically, but spiritually live forever - in hell or in heaven, in eternal punishment or eternal life, in eternal suffering or eternal joy.
Every man has sinned, and death is certain for all.
God is holy and heaven is holy so we need to be holy to enter in the heaven.
Leviticus 19:2 'Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.'
1st Corinthians 6:9 'Or do you not know that wrongdoers/sinner will not inherit the kingdom of God?'
Then how one can be righteous or holy?
Hebrews 9:22 'In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.'
To be forgiven of sin is to be holy or to be righteous.
Why blood is important?
Leviticus 17:11 'For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life.'

Since the life is in the blood, no one can pay the price of the life. And no man can extend a life even for a moment by his own. Jesus Christ opened the way for the redemption of the human race by sacrificing his precious blood or precious life.
Hebrews 9:12 'but He (Jesus) entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.'

Jesus Christ shown his love by sacrificing His life for entire human race. According John 15:13 - 'Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.' We cannot find any other example in the world history of this kind of love except Jesus Christ.
1st John 1:7 'But if we walk in the light, as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, HIS Son, purifies us from all sin'

1st Corinthians 15:3 'For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,''

Revelation 1:5 'and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by His blood,''
Matthew 9:2 'Some men brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, 'Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.' ''

In this saying, Jesus is directly forgiving the sins of the paralyzed man, because Jesus is able to forgive the sins of man and in the same time, He also declares himself as God, because except God no one can forgive the sin.
Acts 10:43 'All the prophets testify about Him (Christ) that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.'
Acts 4:12 'Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved' except Jesus Christ of Nazareth.
1st John 2:2 'He (Christ) is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.'
John 3:16 'For God (creator) so loved the world (human race) that he gave HIS one and only Son (Jesus Christ), that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.'
John 1:12 'Yet to all who did receive Him (Jesus), to those who believed in His (Jesus) Name, he gave the right to become children of God'
The word 'children of God' is not a simple word, those who believed and received Jesus as their Lord are counted as the citizen of Heaven, counted as the holy person, their all sins are forgiven.

Romans 8:1-2 'Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus, because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.'
Romans 5:9 'Since we have now been justified by His (Jesus) blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through him!'
Romans 3:24 'and all are justified freely by His (Jesus) grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.'
John 14:6 'Jesus answered, 'I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father (who is in heaven) except through me.''
Those who believe in Jesus Christ they only can enter in Heaven, that is called Eternal Life.
John 3:15 'that everyone who believes may have eternal life in Him (Christ).'
Romans 6:23 'For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.'
John 5:24 Jesus says - 'Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes HIM who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.'
John 11:25-26 Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die; and whoever lives by believing in me will never die.' '
John 6:51 'I am (Christ) the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.'

Jesus used the word 'Eternal Life' in the Gospel according to John about 17 times, 12 times He used for the present tense, only 5 times He used for the future tense. Most of us think that Eternal life is only for future time, but Bible says clearly that for both present and future time. Those who all are with Jesus, those who believes and accepted Jesus as their personal Lord and Saviour they can say that ETERNAL LIFE is with them, they are already blessed with the Eternal Life.
1st John 5:11 'And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in HIS Son (Christ).'
John 17:3 'Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.'
John 12:50 Jesus said - Jesus said 'I know that His (God's) command leads to eternal life. So, whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.'

1st John 5:20 'We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.'
John 6:47 'Very truly I (Christ) tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.'
What does it mean to believe?
Demons also believe in Jesus that doesn't mean that they will have eternal life. James 2:19 You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that - and shudder.
Repent for your sin, confess that God raised Jesus Christ from the dead, and Accept Jesus Christ as your person saviour and Lord. - that is called as believe in Jesus Christ.

Romans 10:9-10 'If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.'
Matthew 10:32-33 'Whoever acknowledges me before others, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven. But whoever disowns me before others, I will disown before my Father in heaven.'

Salvation or forgiveness of sin is the key to eternal life. Only Jesus Christ can save the human race, because no one else in the world has sacrificed his blood except Jesus Christ, Jesus only sacrificed His Holy blood as the final sacrifice for the human race. That is why HE is able to save all mankind.
The importance of Jesus Christ:

There were many prophecies about Jesus Christ between 1700 BC to 400 BC, about His birth, about His punishment, about His death on the cross, about His <u>resurrection</u> on the third day of His death, etc. Scholars estimates that Jesus Christ fulfilled more than 300 prophecies of Old Testament. Even after the resurrection, Christ lived with the disciples and preached about the kingdom of heaven, and on the 40th day of His resurrection ascended to heaven in His bodily form.
Other than Christ, there is no other person in the world history, who has been resurrected and <u>ascended to heaven</u> physically.

Today, the history of the earth counted with Christ. About 88 percent countries of the world keep Sunday as holiday and observes the day of Christ's resurrection, the day of victory, victory over death and sin.

Our only duty is to take refuge in Him, to confess with our mouths that Jesus is the Lord, to believe in our hearts that God has raised Christ from the dead, and to be His disciples and follow His commandments and walk in the way of life, then sure, he/she will possess the kingdom of heaven.
The importance of The Holy Bible
I have mentioned here the references from the Holy Bible to explain about the Eternal life.
And why Bible is a reliable book? Bible is written in the span of 1700 to 1800 years by more than 40 different authors in different age and in different places.

Bible is not a single book, it is the combination of 66 books, before Christ 39 books written that is called 'Old Testament' and after Christ 27 books written that is called 'New Testament'. The purpose of writing the Holy Bible is almost same by all the authors that is to reveal the knowledge of Godhead (Father God, Son God Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit God), reveal the nature of Creation and history of mankind. Also, Bible is known as the God's instructions, Laws, History, Prophecy and Revelation. Also, The Holy Bible is known as the BOOK OF ETERNAL LIFE.

The Holy Bible is not written by a single or 2-3 persons; but written by 40 different people with the historical evidence and everyone's purpose is almost the same, so I can say The Holy Bible is proven and reliable Book.
2nd Timothy 3:16 'All Scripture (Bible) is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.'
John 20:31 'But these are (Bible) written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life (eternal life) in His name.'

The Bible is written so that all mankind would receive forgiveness of sin, salvation, and eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ. The Holy Bible is not written only for any particular country, particular class, particular language, particular color people; But it is written for people of every language, every tribe, every color, and every nation of the earth. Today, The Holy Bible is known as the highest printed Book, and The Holy Bible is available in almost every major languages.

Life is so Precious and Eternal Life is Invaluable. God made a special plan for everyone of us to have the Eternal Life without any cost. So, lets have Life Abundantly and Eternally. And share our Experience of Eternal life with others and make our Lord to be Glorified.
May the Lord bless you abundantly, be blessed with eternal life and be a citizen of the kingdom of HEAVEN.
